stories.title: Roadworks: what’s happening on Flintshire’s roads this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire and Deeside face a number of road closures and temporary traffic lights this week, with several new schemes starting. New closures this week Stag Lane in Ewloe Shotton is closed from 14 to 18 September for United Utilities water works. Golftyn Lane in Connah’s Quay is closed from 14 to 25 September

stories.title: Residents’ meeting planned over Sandycroft fly-tipping problem
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is inviting Sandycroft residents to a meeting to discuss plans to tackle fly-tipping in the area’s alleyways. The council’s Keep Flintshire Tidy team says it has secured funding for CCTV following a recent residents’ survey on fly-tipping. stories.title: Nine-bedroom holiday let approved for barns at Rhydymwyn farm
stories.summary: Redundant barns at a farm near Mold have been approved for conversion into a nine-bedroom holiday let. Flintshire County Council’s planning committee approved the application for Tyddyn Y Gwynt Farm, Rhydymwyn, on 11 September. The application was submitted by agents Paterson Macaulay & Owens Ltd.
